'''Playland Theatre''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], next to [[Purple Werm/Legends|Purple Werm]]. A run-down, [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon sign stated the name of the establishment.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment right across the street, while planning the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|Mission to the Jedi Temple]].
